title: Russian Spies Allegedly Plot to Assassinate German Drone Executive
description:
Russian intelligence services reportedly orchestrated a plot to assassinate Stefan Thumann, CEO of German drone manufacturer Donaustahl. The plan was thwarted by German security forces following alerts from allied intelligence agencies. Two suspects, a Ukrainian man and a Romanian woman, were arrested for surveillance activities conducted from December 2025 to March 2026. They monitored Thumann's movements, photographing his residence and workplace. Despite initial arrests, one suspect escaped to Spain, complicating the investigation. German authorities have classified the case as a 'presumed planned assassination,' although formal charges focus on espionage activities. Thumann is currently under heightened security protection.

Key Points:
• Russian intelligence allegedly planned an assassination of a German drone executive.
• Two suspects were arrested, including a Romanian woman and a Ukrainian man.
• The operation was thwarted due to timely alerts from allied intelligence agencies.
